name.ja: 恐竜骨格プラモデル トリケラトプス

description.ja: 触 れ て 感 じ る 生 命 の 記 憶 ―
description.en: Memories of life that you can touch and feel.

description.ja: 恐 竜 骨 格 プ ラ モ デ ル
description.en: dinosaur skeleton plastic model

description.ja: 恐竜骨格をプラモデル化。恐竜骨格プラモデル「トリケラトプス」が登場。
description.en: Plastic model of dinosaur skeleton. Introducing the dinosaur skeleton plastic model "Triceratops".

description.ja: 鉱物を多く含む新素材「ＬＩＭＥＸ」を採用。頭から尻尾までを約160mmのこだわりの造形で再現。
description.en: Adopts a new material "LIMEX" containing a lot of minerals. The figure is carefully sculpted with a length of approximately 160mm from head to tail.

description.ja: ＬＩＭＥＸとは・・・
description.en: What is LIMEX?

description.ja: ＜地球環境に優しい新素材＞
description.en: <New material that is friendly to the global environment>

description.ja: 日本で生まれた新たな成形材料。
description.en: A new molding material created from a book.

description.ja: 主原料が石灰石を５０％以上含み、従来の石油由来樹脂の使用を大きく削減。
description.en: The main raw material contains over 50% limestone, greatly reducing the use of conventional petroleum-derived resins.

description.ja: ＣＯ２排出削減にも貢献できる材料として、持続可能な資源循環を目指しています。
description.en: We aim for sustainable resource circulation as a material that can also contribute to reducing CO2 emissions.

description.ja: ●　新素材「ＬＩＭＥＸ」を採用することで化石という存在にリアリティを宿し、太古に躍動した命の息吹を感じられるプラモデルに
description.en: ● By using the new material "LIMEX", the existence of fossils is imbued with reality, creating a plastic model that allows you to feel the breath of life that flourished in ancient times.

description.ja: ［触感］
description.en: [Tactile sensation]

description.ja: 石膏のような乾いた手触り
description.en: Dry texture like plaster

description.ja: ［質感］
description.en: [Texture]

description.ja: マットな表面が柔らかな光沢を帯びる
description.en: Matte surface has a soft luster

description.ja: ［重量］
description.en: [weight]

description.ja: 従来のプラスチックよりも石灰石の比重が多く、重さを感じる
description.en: The specific gravity of limestone is higher than that of conventional plastics, making it feel heavier.

description.ja: ●　関節部分はパーツが分割されているため、イメージに合わせた姿勢で展示が可能
description.en: ● The joints are divided into parts, so you can display it in a posture that matches your image.

description.ja: ●　植物をすり潰す植物食恐竜の独特な歯の形状を再現。こだわりの造形で再現
description.en: ● Reproduces the unique tooth shape of plant-eating dinosaurs that grind plants. Reproduced with special modeling

description.en: *Runner is labeled as "PS", but the material of the product is a composite material made of limestone (calcium carbonate) as the main raw material combined with PS.
